text:
maria: Quick question about /v2/generate behavior — if a client sends stop=["\n", "###"] and max_tokens=0 what should we return? Should we still include logprobs metadata when zero tokens are emitted?
aj: Historically v1 returned an empty "generations" array for max_tokens=0 and omitted logprobs. Is that the expected contract for v2 too?
ben: Current runtime behavior: we short-circuit on max_tokens==0 and return a single item with empty text but we still attach logprobs: {} which broke one customer yesterday. Example request:
```
POST /v2/generate
{ "model":"redwood-2","input":"...","max_tokens":0,"stop":["\n","###"],"logprobs":5 }
```
samir: I see. For stop sequences: we only check stop after token emission. So if max_tokens==0 we never check stop (no tokens generated). That's fine, but contract needs to be explicit.
qa-jun: Customer reported mismatch between v1 and v2 in prod -> flagged in support. We need a clear compat doc + tests. Can we add an integration test that asserts no logprobs when generations empty?
aj: Agreed. Implementation options:
- Follow v1: when max_tokens==0 return empty text and omit logprobs completely.
- Or keep current (attach empty logprobs object). I prefer v1 for least surprise.
ben: I'll open a small PR to change runtime to not attach logprobs when no tokens generated, and add a changelog entry. Also adding unit tests for stop sequences that are prefixes of tokens (token-boundary edge cases).
maria: Also related: temperature vs top_p interplay. Do we currently apply both when both provided, or does one override? I recall earlier we documented "both are allowed and combined" but sampling impl might behave differently.
aj: We currently compute sampling like: apply temperature scaling then do nucleus sampling with top_p on the scaled distribution. So both are applied. However that wasn't clearly documented in API contract — good catch.
samir: PR #4832 draft adds tests for: 1) stop matched at token boundary, 2) max_tokens=0 => no logprobs, 3) temperature+top_p combined sampling expectations. Putting test vectors in tests/integration/genparams/.
qa-jun: Please add an explicit integration test that simulates a client with both fields and checks distribution shape, even if nondeterministic — assert we run both ops not that output equals.
ben: I'll also add a compatibility flag `compatMode=v1` for Dedicated customers who need strict old behavior while we roll out change. Will coordinate with product for defaults.
maria: Sounds good. Can @aj and @ben review #4832? assigning now. I'll update docs/api/generate.md with explicit rules for stop vs max_tokens and for sampling order.
aj: Reviewing tomorrow morning. leaving small comments on tests.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for commit a1b2c3 on infra/genparams — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks all — next steps: merge PR after review, add changelog line, add integration test to regression suite, and note behavioral change in release notes. :thumbsup:
